downloads.label:
MP3: XY stereo recording of late dawn streamlet of Sunyani wetland, Ghana.
09-03-2026. This is my first field recording after i received field recording introductions by CSEM founder Samuel Kudjodzi. In the recording: Constant pouring of a streamlet in a Sunyani wetland in the Bono Region of Ghana. Coucals and a puddle frog (Phrynobatrachus latifrons) can be heard within the stereo image. This streamlet is surrounded by human dwellings, so domestic animal and human activity can be perceived in the background. Ground support is provided by Emmanuel Boateng. Monitoring, Editing, and Mastering by Samuel Kudjodzi, CSEM Founder, Germany.
